about: Almond starter assemblies (own work, MIT). Layers run from outside to inside; internal floors run from the ceiling below up to the walking surface, internal walls from side A to side B. Material properties come from materials.json (EnergyPlus / ASHRAE HOF data), finishes' reflectance and absorptance are Almond assumptions. Thermal bridging by studs, ties and fixings is not included: treat timber-frame and fixed-insulation U-values as lower bounds. Ventilated claddings and their cavities are left out, as the EN ISO 6946 procedure does for well-ventilated layers.
